shortDescription: Manages outputting logs on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: channel_cfg_name
options.description: Channel name.The value is a string of 1 to 30 case-sensitive characters. The default value is console.

options.name: channel_id
options.description: Number for channel. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 9. The default value is 0.

options.name: channel_name
options.description: Channel name. The value is a string of 1 to 30 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: channel_out_direct
options.description: Direction of information output.

options.name: facility
options.description: Log record tool.

options.name: filter_feature_name
options.description: Feature name of the filtered log. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-insensitive characters.

options.name: filter_log_name
options.description: Name of the filtered log. The value is a string of 1 to 63 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: info_center_enable
options.description: Whether the info-center function is enabled. The value is of the Boolean type.

options.name: ip_type
options.description: Log server address type, IPv4 or IPv6.

options.name: is_default_vpn
options.description: Use the default VPN or not.

options.name: level
options.description: Level of logs saved on a log server.

options.name: logfile_max_num
options.description: Maximum number of log files of the same type. The default value is 200. The value range for log files is[3, 500], for security files is [1, 3],and for operation files is [1, 7].

options.name: logfile_max_size
options.description: Maximum size (in MB) of a log file. The default value is 32. The value range for log files is [4, 8, 16, 32], for security files is [1, 4], and for operation files is [1, 4].

options.name: packet_priority
options.description: Set the priority of the syslog packet.The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 7. The default value is 0.

options.name: server_domain
options.description: Server name. The value is a string of 1 to 255 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: server_ip
options.description: Log server address, IPv4 or IPv6 type. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters. The value can be an valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

options.name: server_port
options.description: Number of a port sending logs.The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535. For UDP, the default value is 514. For TCP, the default value is 601. For TSL, the default value is 6514.

options.name: source_ip
options.description: Log source ip address, IPv4 or IPv6 type. The value is a string of 0 to 255. The value can be an valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

options.name: ssl_policy_name
options.description: SSL policy name. The value is a string of 1 to 23 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: suppress_enable
options.description: Whether a device is enabled to suppress duplicate statistics. The value is of the Boolean type.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: Log server timestamp. The value is of the enumerated type and case-sensitive.

options.name: transport_mode
options.description: Transport mode. The value is of the enumerated type and case-sensitive.

options.name: vrf_name
options.description: VPN name on a log server. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters. The default value is _public_.
